## 中文

`v0.9.3` 支持 DSH `0.2.2-rc.2`。启用推理强度滑块后，模型菜单会保留 Agent Teams 开关和其他原生选项。 [Issue #27](https://github.com/HanaAyane/dsh-reasoning-effort/issues/27)

### 通过 npm 安装

桌面端在 **插件 → 添加插件 → 包名或地址** 中填入 `@ayanehana/dsh-reasoning-effort@0.9.3`，安装后按界面提示重新加载。

Web 端运行下方命令，然后重启 Web Host 并刷新页面。

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @ayanehana/dsh-reasoning-effort@0.9.3
```

[npm 包页面](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ayanehana/dsh-reasoning-effort/v/0.9.3)

## English

`v0.9.3` supports DSH `0.2.2-rc.2`. The model menu keeps the Agent Teams toggle and other native options when the reasoning-effort slider is enabled. [Issue #27](https://github.com/HanaAyane/dsh-reasoning-effort/issues/27)

### Install from npm

On Desktop, open **Plugins → Add plugin → Package name or address** and enter `@ayanehana/dsh-reasoning-effort@0.9.3`. Reload when prompted.

For Web, run the command below, then restart the Web Host and refresh the page.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @ayanehana/dsh-reasoning-effort@0.9.3
```

[npm package page](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ayanehana/dsh-reasoning-effort/v/0.9.3)
